name: Kimi no Kao ga Mienai.
source:
Being married for 4 years, the main character thought of his marriage successful.
Until the day he finds a photo of a woman who looks exactly like his wife on a spy photo website.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE064038.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主人公结婚四年，一直以为自己的婚姻很成功。
直到有一天，他在一个偷拍照片网站上看到了一名长得和妻子一模一样的女人。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE064038.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
